notes: Every timed method runs in a fresh process; order is randomized per repeat.
Independent and manual baselines stream the H5AD in backed mode.
CellVault conversion is reported separately from recurring aggregation.
requested_rows counts logical task membership; unique_rows counts source rows.
logical matrix reads are API batch reads, not physical chunks or decompressions.
Benchmark JSON/NPZ validation files are not counted as workflow artifacts.
Validation NPZ files are deleted after comparison unless --keep-validation-arrays is set.
Floating aggregates use rtol=1e-6 and atol=1e-8; integer sums are exact.
